entities.name: Leonid Zhabotinsky
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Leonid Ivanovich Zhabotinsky was a Soviet weightlifter who set 19 world records in the superheavyweight class, and won gold medals at the 1964 and 1968 Olympic Games.
